item.title: Fascial Liquid Crystals: Why Movement is Quantum Information
item.description:
Standard biomechanics views the human body as a collection of isolated levers, bones, and pulleys. Somatic architecture looks deeper: into the collagen matrix.

The Semiconductor of the Body

Fascia is not inert packing tissue. It is a continuous, body-wide liquid crystal network capable of transmitting piezoelectric signals faster than standard unmyelinated nerve conduction.

  • Fluid Dynamics: Interstitial fluid and cerebrospinal rhythm (CSF) create coherent pressure waves.
  • 0.1 Hz Resonance: When breath, cardiovascular dynamics, and fascial spiral micro-movements sync, sympathetic overload drops automatically.
  • Compensation Resolution: You cannot release deep spinal tension by simply stretching. You must alter the tone of the neural container.
